observations: Current Compete Row holds title, eyebrow, points, rank and a supported sentence; optional league look is injected but rows visibly use ordinary ink and neutral rules.

LookRoomSection already gives The Pro a Dress the room control. LookResolver resolves phase, Pro choice, personal choice in that order; identity persistence must be distinguished from transient phase styling.
Me.Membership and LeagueRoom.League in the reviewed source do not expose a league cover/logo or short description.

Member profiles and existing photo/marker fallbacks are available in the LeagueRoom member read; bootstrap memberships contain counts and The Pro name, not a full avatar preview. Avoid one extra member-list fetch per league.
Me.Standing carries current rank, points and prev_rank; Movement requires the source snapshot date. Bare prev_rank does not establish a latest-round or complete season trend.
D381 Book race is points counting today by contribution week, with restatement after best-N displacement; it is not historical standings.
Existing CompeteRoot owns deadline ordering, invitations, phase semantics, points ties and finished history. Identity must join that producer without changing game rules.

selectedDirection.name: Club Spread
brief: Make leagues recognizable by their identity and friends. Lead each Compete entry with a square group/course photo, uploaded logo, or designed initial mark beside the league name.

Show a short description, actual member photos/markers with names and a correct remaining count, then one compact phase-correct season summary. Reflow descriptions and season facts full width whenever they need room; never squeeze long names or prose into a narrow column.

Let The Pro optionally manage image, an existing curated color pair, and description. Carry the same identity into that league's pages and Run it back, preserving phase semantics and each person's marker identity.

Use the existing native design system and personal light/dark choice. Cover photo, logo, fallback, long text, solo/squad and season states. Profile stays unchanged; broad trend charts are deferred. Metadata, uploads and member-preview reads need backend work before this can ship.
selectedDirection.briefStatus: Explicitly confirmed by the owner in chat; implementation authorized September 30.

visualReview.correction: One targeted image edit reduced Club Index's identity tiles and added quieter secondary doors so it differs materially from Club Spread.
visualReview.confirmedVisible: All three images loaded in the local comparison page.
visualReview.implementationLimits: The native build must use actual fonts, tokens, person marker identities, phase-aware facts, image loading states and routes. Illustrative people discs and geometric emblems do not authorize recoloring actual avatars. Preserve complete prose measures and avoid literalizing incidental image-generator texture or gradients. No native implementation or simulator verification is claimed.

proposedPlan: Retain shared league identity across Run it back. Recommend optional image/logo, curated existing color pair, and a short owner-authored description; no required customization at league creation.
Carry the same identifying mark/colors into the season header without taking over the standings, Book or navigation. Keep each person's dark/light setting and protected action/live/earned roles.
Show a few actual member photos or existing marker fallbacks and a correct remaining count. Use a batched authorized preview read if necessary; do not fabricate people.
Use one compact, phase-correct season summary with existing rank/points/gap producers. Add a dated movement sentence only if its source snapshot is available; defer broad trend charts.
Design complete photo, logo and initial-mark variants, long names and descriptions, one/two/many leagues, solo and squads, every season phase, loading/failed reads and failed imagery.
Club Spread and the final brief are confirmed. Planning is complete; schema/RPC/storage work and any deployment remain separately reviewable during implementation.

referenceComparisons.name: Formula 1 teams
